title: Azania Capital Limited
shortDesc: Investment banking, advisory, and capital market solutions through Azania Capital Limited.
desc1: Azania Capital Limited is the investment and capital markets arm of Azania Bank, providing specialist services to corporates, institutions, and high-net-worth clients.
desc2: From capital raising to advisory and structured finance, Azania Capital connects clients to opportunities in Tanzania and beyond.

benefits.title: Specialist Expertise
benefits.desc: Access dedicated capital markets and investment professionals.

benefits.title: Integrated Banking
benefits.desc: Leverage the full Azania Bank group relationship.

benefits.title: Market Access
benefits.desc: Connect to local and regional capital market opportunities.

faqs.question: What is Azania Capital Limited?
faqs.answer: Azania Capital Limited is a subsidiary of Azania Bank providing investment banking and capital market services.

faqs.question: Who are the target clients?
faqs.answer: Services are aimed at corporates, institutional investors, and qualified individual clients.

faqs.question: How do I engage Azania Capital?
faqs.answer: Contact the Azania Capital desk through your relationship manager or visit our head office.

title: FOREX
shortDesc: Buy and sell foreign currency for trade, travel, and investment needs.
desc1: Azania Bank FOREX services support individuals and businesses with competitive exchange rates and reliable currency transactions.
desc2: Whether you need USD, EUR, GBP, or other major currencies for imports, exports, or personal travel, our treasury team provides professional execution.

benefits.title: Competitive Rates
benefits.desc: Access market-aligned exchange rates for your transactions.

benefits.title: Trade Support
benefits.desc: Facilitate import and export payments in foreign currency.

faqs.question: What currencies are available?
faqs.answer: Major currencies including USD, EUR, and GBP are available subject to market conditions and regulatory requirements.

faqs.question: Can businesses get forward FX contracts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Corporate clients can access forward FX arrangements subject to credit and documentation requirements.

faqs.question: Where can I buy or sell foreign currency?
faqs.answer: FOREX transactions are available at designated branches and through corporate treasury for business clients.

title: Capital Market Services
titleLarge: Access to capital markets and securities services
shortDesc: Securities trading, custody, and capital market participation for institutional and corporate clients.
desc1: Azania Bank Capital Market Services connect clients to securities markets with professional execution, custody, and advisory support.
desc2: From government securities to corporate bonds and equities, we help clients participate in Tanzania's growing capital markets.

benefits.title: Market Participation
benefits.desc: Access primary and secondary capital markets efficiently.

benefits.title: Secure Custody
benefits.desc: Hold securities with a regulated banking institution.

benefits.title: Informed Decisions
benefits.desc: Benefit from market insights and professional guidance.

faqs.question: What capital market products are available?
faqs.answer: Products include government securities, corporate bonds, and equities subject to market availability and client eligibility.

faqs.question: Who can access capital market services?
faqs.answer: Services are available to corporates, institutional investors, and qualified individual clients.

faqs.question: How do I open a securities account?
faqs.answer: Contact the capital markets desk with required KYC documentation to begin the account opening process.
